description: This file is an HTML document defining the frontend interface for a database viewer application. It contains the structure, styles, and embedded JavaScript code for rendering database lists, tables, and data entries, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a specified database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a selected table in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data array into an HTML table with interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings for expanded view.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.
